description: Machine-readable schema for the submission and finance-review templates. Validators read this file; column lists are never hardcoded elsewhere.

columns.name: receipt_file
columns.rule: must exist under receipts/ when present; blank allowed only for per-diem lines or items the policy exempts from receipts

columns.name: receipt_total
columns.rule: printed total of the receipt; same value on every line split from that receipt

cross_row_rules: For each receipt_file: sum(price) of its lines == receipt_total (tolerance 0.01)
No two lines share vendor + date + price + receipt_file

finance_review.role: source of truth — claims.csv and exceptions-queue.csv are derived from it

columns.name: submitted_amount
columns.rule: copied from submission; blank if the employee left it blank

columns.name: receipt_amount
columns.rule: finance's own re-read of the receipt; blank if unreadable

columns.name: policy_clause
columns.rule: clause ID from the stored policy, or UNSPECIFIED

row_rules: base = receipt_amount if present, else submitted_amount
REDUCE   → 0 < claimable_amount < base and non_claimable_amount == base - claimable_amount
ESCALATE → claimable_amount == 0 and non_claimable_amount == 0 and action_needed is not blank
receipt_amount != submitted_amount → verdict_code == MANIFEST-MISMATCH and reason states both numbers
currency != policy reporting currency → decision == ESCALATE unless the policy defines an FX source
file_rules: exactly one row per submission.csv line, same line numbers
claims.csv rows appended by this review == rows with decision APPROVE or REDUCE; their claimable sum == sum(claimable_amount)
exceptions-queue.csv rows appended by this review == rows with decision ESCALATE
